answer: One-Time Challenge Whisper. Each agent receives a private, single-use task whose answer derives from a secret only it holds; correct replies are recorded once and any replay is rejected. A shared terrace of verifiers cross-checks answer uniqueness before admitting the agent. Identity issuance is gated at a public jetty where newcomers must complete a fresh challenge, so mass-registration costs one real computation and unique secret per fake identity, making sybil scaling linear in compute and storage rather than free.
